subject_executed: TNT (Transformer-in-Transformer) on CIFAR-10. Source: github.com/huawei-noah/CV-Backbones commit f90e129b645c3b1684fe07cd361cd557d0ad71f7 (tnt_pytorch/tnt.py). Config: img_size=32, patch_size=8, inner_stride=4, n_inner=4, d_inner=24, outer_dim=192, depth=6, outer_num_heads=3, inner_num_heads=4, seed=42. Sanity checks: (a) init CE, (b) 500-step test acc, (c) 300-step overfit 32-image batch, (d) reproducibility over 5 batches.
notes: All 4 sanity checks PASS. Geometry pre-analysis (gates 5 & 6): n_inner=4 < d_inner=24 so linear-attention has no FLOP advantage at this scale; inner-block attention is ~10% of total attention FLOPs; max achievable total-model cut by fully removing inner-block attention < 10%; the '12-18% total FLOP reduction' claim is arithmetically refuted before any ablation run. Study is reframed as expressivity-only as specified in EXPERIMENT.md. Data loaded via HuggingFace uoft-cs/cifar10 (identical to torchvision CIFAR-10 but 3000x faster download on this machine). No weights saved to disk.
